title: A goldsmith who played baritone and inspired Pat Neasel
summary: A jeweler named Miller played baritone, and Neasel took up baritone after hearing him; the professor advised a good new instrument.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
